Figure viewed at full resolution with crops: the auto-interpretation panel prints Glasgow HR 84 and PBI HR 79 with ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, while the caption states 135 bpm; 135 is not printed anywhere and the printed rates are below the article's own RVR threshold (HR > 100 bpm), so the caption cannot be tied to these pixels.
